sources.title: IBM i 7.4 — Work with TCP/IP Network Sts (NETSTAT)

asciiPanel:
Work with TCP/IP Network Status
                                                         System:   SYS1

Select one of the following:

  1. Work with TCP/IP interface status
  2. Display TCP/IP route information
  3. Work with TCP/IP connection status

Selection or command ===>
F3=Exit F4=Prompt F9=Retrieve F12=Cancel
notes: NETSTAT OPTION(*SELECT) shows the menu; OPTION(*CNN) or menu option 3 opens connection status. IPv6 variants use *IFC6/*CNN6 per IBM 7.4 command reference.
